title: Source
description: A Source is an authoritative Source Registry record: an approved, monitored or monitorable intelligence source. It is the promotion target for approved SourceCandidate records (SourceCandidate.promotion.promoted_source_id points to this record's source_id, and provenance.promoted_from_candidate_ids points back). A Source is NOT a SourceCandidate, and it is NOT a Raw Document, Parsed Document, Evidence, Claim, Signal, BankNeed, Opportunity, Wiki, Graph, Retrieval, or Dashboard. It defines collection method, refresh cadence, expected update pattern, access/legal status, and collection_allowed, and it STORES monitoring state (last_checked_at, next_check_at, last_successful_ingestion_at, failure_count) - but it must NOT perform acquisition and must NOT decide that nothing changed. Collection/check EXECUTION belongs to future acquisition connectors: monitoring_state is connector/scheduler-owned and deterministic; the promotion workflow only initializes it; LLMs must never update it. The registry contains no change-detection state (no content hash, no last_change_at, no 'unchanged' flag) - that lives in acquisition logs/documents.

source_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this Source Registry record (promotion target; SourceCandidate.promotion.promoted_source_id points here).

provenance.description: How this record originated. Referential integrity of candidate<->source links is the promotion workflow's responsibility, not schema-enforceable.

origin.description: How the record entered the registry. 'promoted_from_candidate' = via the controlled promotion workflow (requires promoted_from_candidate_ids, enforced below); 'manual_seed' = seed-registry entry (architecture section 10 one-off/manual exception); 'imported' = bulk import.

promoted_from_candidate_ids.description: candidate_ids of the SourceCandidate(s) that promoted/merged into this source. Non-empty when origin is 'promoted_from_candidate' (enforced below). An array to support candidate merges (SourceCandidate.promotion.promotion_status 'merged').

promoted_by.description: Who ran the promotion; null for non-promoted origins.

promoted_at.description: When promoted (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time); null for non-promoted origins.

origin_discovery_run_id.description: discovery_run_id that originally surfaced this source; null if not applicable.

created_at.description: When the registry record was created (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

updated_at.description: When the registry record was last updated (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

url_or_endpoint.description: Primary URL or API endpoint of the source.

source_class.description: Source class. Strict 3-value set (matching SourceCandidate) - a registered source has a known class; the extended 'unknown'/'not_applicable' values used by NegativeFinding/CoverageGap do not apply here.

source_subtype.description: Finer classification within source_class, aligned with SourceCandidate.source_subtype (e.g. 'procurement_portal', 'central_bank', 'bank_register').

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'GR'). Use the sentinel 'ZZ' when global_scope is true (a global/multi-country source not tied to one country). Kept required for indexing.

country_name.description: Optional display name of the country, e.g. 'Greece'.

global_scope.description: True when the source is global/multi-country and not tied to a single country. When true, country should be the sentinel 'ZZ'.

sector.description: Which side of Printec's market the source serves.

workstreams.description: Workstream codes this source serves (architecture section 16; A7 intentionally not defined). PLURAL by deliberate divergence from SourceCandidate.workstream (single): a monitored source is long-lived and routinely serves multiple workstreams.

topics.description: Non-empty list of topics the source covers.

primary_language.description: The source's primary language as a BCP-47-like tag where possible, e.g. 'el', 'en'. Lenient shape check, not full BCP-47 validation.

related_entities.description: Optional related banks, payment actors, regulators, vendors, etc.

source_publisher_type.description: Optional publisher type, e.g. 'regulator', 'bank', 'vendor', 'media', 'association'. Carries byte-for-byte from SourceCandidate.source_publisher_type.

source_owner.description: Optional EXTERNAL entity that operates/publishes the source (not the internal steward - see record_owner).

bias_profile.description: Optional known bias or perspective of the source.

usefulness_score.description: Estimated value of the source to its workstreams, 0..1 (carried from SourceCandidate). Note: SourceCandidate.confidence_score is intentionally NOT carried - it is candidate-assessment only.

reason_to_track.description: Why this source is monitored (typically carried from SourceCandidate.discovery_basis.why_relevant).

coverage_notes.description: Optional notes on what this source does and does not cover.

collection_method.description: Chosen acquisition method (architecture section 11 preferred order). This is the ACQUISITION CONTRACT connectors dispatch on, so it includes 'sitemap' - a deliberate (temporary) divergence from SourceCandidate.suggested_collection_method, which should gain 'sitemap' later. The registry only DEFINES the method; connectors execute it.

refresh_cadence.description: How often the source should be checked. The scheduler derives monitoring_state.next_check_at deterministically from this + last_checked_at; the registry does not compute it live.

expected_update_pattern.description: Optional prose describing the source's real-world update pattern (e.g. 'tender notices weekday mornings').

collection_allowed.description: Whether automated collection is currently permitted. MUST be false when access_status is 'forbidden_do_not_collect', legal_status is 'forbidden', review_status is 'rejected'/'suspended'/'superseded', or active_status is 'retired'/'disabled'; and MUST be true when active_status is 'active' (all enforced below). Note: intermediate access_status values (e.g. requires_paid_subscription) describe access DIFFICULTY, not prohibition, and do NOT force collection_allowed - the resolved permission is a human/workflow decision.

cost_budget.description: Optional cost budget for paid access. Null values where unknown.

access_status.description: Access boundary per sourcing_layer_scope.md section 7 (identical to SourceCandidate.access_status).

legal_status.description: Legal disposition for collecting from this source (identical to SourceCandidate.legal_status).

retention_policy.description: Retention policy for collected artifacts. Nullable free-text for now; not enum-constrained until the legal/retention policy is formalized.

redistribution_allowed.description: Whether collected content may be redistributed. Default conservatively to false when unknown.

collection_notes.description: Optional operational notes about collecting from this source.

access_review_task_id.description: Optional AccessReviewTask task_id if access/legal help was needed.

monitoring_state.description: CONNECTOR/SCHEDULER-OWNED monitoring state. The promotion workflow INITIALIZES these (failure_count 0, timestamps null); future deterministic acquisition connectors UPDATE them. LLMs and sourcing routines must NOT update them. Contains NO change-detection state (no content hash, no last_change_at, no 'unchanged' flag) - change detection lives in acquisition logs/documents, never here. A non-collectable source may still carry next_check_at for a scheduled access/legal re-review (not collection).

last_checked_at.description: When the source was last checked by a connector; null until first checked.

next_check_at.description: When the source is next scheduled to be checked (for collection when collection_allowed, or for access/legal re-review otherwise); null if unscheduled.

last_successful_ingestion_at.description: When a connector last successfully ingested from this source; null until first success.

failure_count.description: Consecutive/accumulated collection failure count; initialized to 0 at promotion, updated by connectors.

review_status.description: Governance review state of the registry record. This enum is intentionally different from SourceCandidate.review.review_status: it tracks registry-record governance, not candidate-lifecycle review. Records enter as 'approved' (only approved candidates promote in). The stop-states 'rejected'/'suspended'/'superseded' force the source out of active collection (active_status not 'active' and collection_allowed false, enforced below).

active_status.description: Monitoring activity state. 'active' requires collection_allowed=true; 'retired'/'disabled' force collection_allowed=false (a true kill-switch); 'paused' is a temporary hold and does NOT force the permission either way. All enforced below. Initialized to 'active' at promotion when collection_allowed, else 'paused'.

reviewer.description: Optional identifier of the last human reviewer; null if none.

reviewed_at.description: Optional last review time (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time); null if none.

record_owner.description: INTERNAL Printec/system owner accountable for reviewing and maintaining this registry record (distinct from source_owner, the external operator). REQUIRED and non-empty: every registry record must have an accountable internal owner. The promotion workflow supplies it via mandatory human assignment (Q4); a Source can never exist without one.

metadata.description: Optional free-form extension bag. This is the ONLY place additional properties are allowed.
